title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode7 What's Ahead

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It looks like a regular station platform, but things are clearly a bit off here and there...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was just as surprised when I saw this place for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do new areas appear in SEKAI like this often?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I've never heard of this happening until now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But this SEKAI was born out of you girls' feelings, so they may have something to do with this place.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Maybe something has changed now that we've actually gone pro.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Like our expectations for the future, our worries or our idea of where we're headed...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Where we're headed...
Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Where do these tracks go?
They seem to extend towards that sky...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if these tracks lead to where you girls want to go as a band?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think it's coming from the station's speakers. But why...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's the song that made me want to start pursuing music seriously.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hearing this song was the beginning of it all.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've always been really stubborn and struggled to play well with others.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But music showed me that it's okay to pursue my own path.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it just means that I'm not cut out for playing in a band...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't go back now, and I have no way to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is all I can really do for the time being...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even when it came to music, I tried to act tough and tell myself I couldn't play with others.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I felt a lot more comfortable on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And past me convinced herself that going pro meant going it alone.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought about it for a really long time and still felt that I want to be in a band with you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why we all made the decision to come here and tell you exactly how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to play music that can move people with you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We've been able to go pro because they were willing to make that commitment.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And all we have to do now is keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh?
The train's doors just opened...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But why?
They were tightly shut a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does it want us to board...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm starting to think that you and the others are supposed to board this train so that it can take you wherever these tracks lead.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The future? Where we want to go as pros...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because this isn't just my dream anymore.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I shouldn't jump ahead and board it alone...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I want us to go together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really have no idea where we're going to end up.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I'm sure it'll be somewhere nice as long as we stick together...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're going to get in a solid practice together today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll stay as long as you need me to.
